items.title: Armand Hug Interview, 1965-09-13
items.q: That's Roger Wolfe. It was Roger Wolfe, the old disc jockey from WDSU. It was his label.

ctx.x: Well, that was the beginning of the revival of Dixieland around 1949. It was on a label called Bandwagon. That's Roger Wolfe. It was Roger Wolfe, the old disc jockey from WDSU. It was his label.

Okay. Now, I haven't been on the jazz scene very long, but ever since I've been on and I've been reading in jazz journals, it seems to me that you've, I've never seen a review that says anything bad about Alman Haugen. I've read the old jazz record magazine and Record Changer and Downbeat and Metronome. I really don't think that you ever had a negative review. It's a remarkable thing. Do you collect your clippings? Do you save these things? Yes.
